features.label: Restaurant main roof envelope
features.notes: Composite roof edge excluding NW narrow canopy and white terrace. Dark NW and terracotta SE slopes with multiple dormers. Southwest junction is complex; inspect photos and laser before deriving walls. Approximate edge-picking uncertainty 0.5–1.0 m; source absolute accuracy not assessed.

features.label: Restaurant northwest narrow roof or canopy
features.notes: Narrow dark strip beside restaurant NW side; roofing/canopy interpretation requires ground photo. Separate from main envelope to preserve the visible joint.

features.label: Reception and club office wing
features.notes: Detached southwest wing; terracotta gabled roof. Club site map A identifies reception/kansli. Roof edge uncertainty approximately 0.5 m, not wall survey.

features.label: Changing rooms and lodging annex wing
features.notes: Detached southeast wing; roof envelope includes small east projection. Club map I identifies changing rooms; club 2024 newsletter says rooms share annex with changing rooms. Roof dormers visible; exact wall and projection layout needs photo confirmation.

features.label: Annex northwest small roof extension
features.notes: Small roof at northwest end of annex; physical connection and function unresolved.

features.label: Courtyard southwest canopy
features.notes: Small courtyard roof; keep as open canopy only if photos corroborate. No walls inferred.

features.label: Courtyard northeast canopy
features.notes: Small courtyard roof. Structure and fascia visible from above; wall enclosure not established.

features.label: Golf cart shelter
features.notes: Long narrow red roof north of restaurant; site map H identifies golf carts. April 2025 shape; do not infer closed long sides.

features.label: Kiosk and toilets building
features.notes: Dark roof north of cart shelter. Club site map G identifies kiosk/toilets; adjacent terrace is separate. Tree and roof shadow obscure southwest corner; estimated edge-picking uncertainty 0.7 m.

features.label: South courtyard small outbuilding
features.notes: Small detached pitched roof south of the courtyard. Function and number of doors unresolved.

features.label: East courtyard long outbuilding
features.notes: Dark elongated roof east of south courtyard. Light wall or equipment row on southwest side; function unconfirmed.

features.label: Small roof beside putting green east path
features.notes: Tiny red roof next to east practice path; not assigned toilet/utility function without evidence.

features.label: Driving range covered shelter, April 2025
features.notes: Long rectangular roof south of putting green at east end of range mat strip. April 2025 roof predates studio and covered range plans announced December 2025; current built condition unverified.

features.label: Northern service-area large roof
features.notes: Large bright southeast roof slope and dark northwest slope. Yard/equipment visible; maintenance use is plausible but not established by orthophoto. Minor roof perspective/orthorectification displacement expected; not wall footprint.

features.label: Northern neighbouring building, west of road-side group
features.notes: Independent nearby roof; inclusion gives course-side context, not evidence of golf-club ownership.

features.label: Northern neighbouring building, north
features.notes: Dark rectangular roof, visible chimney. Ownership and function unconfirmed.

features.label: Northern neighbouring building, east
features.notes: Roof projected outline; raised-roof perspective means silhouette differs from base.

features.label: Northern neighbouring building, south
features.notes: Detached dark roof; no golf-club use established.

features.label: North parking and motorhome hardstanding
features.notes: Visible contiguous hardstanding; plot numbers and present occupancy must come from site map. April 2025 photo visibly has fewer occupied pads; edge under parked cars uncertain by 1–2 m.

features.label: South parking hardstanding
features.notes: Asphalt/gravel parking surface outline, excluding road; internal painted bays and obstructions require separate observation.

features.label: Putting green south of courtyard
features.notes: Visible maintained turf extent in April 2025. Not an official play boundary; shadows and seasonal colour give edge-picking uncertainty of several pixels.

features.label: Driving range mat strip, April 2025
features.notes: Continuous range hitting strip. Individual rectangular pads are visible; topology and covered studio plan may have changed after December 2025.

features.label: Kiosk southwest terrace
features.notes: Narrow platform immediately southwest of kiosk roof, partly tree-shadow obscured. Needs ground photograph before modelling supports/railings.

features.label: Restaurant northwest terrace
features.notes: Bright platform around southwest/northwest end of main building, excluding canopy. Extent partially hidden by roof; approximate image boundary, not measured deck elevation.

features.label: Northern service-context eastern yard
features.notes: Hardstanding traced from northern-service-native.png at 0.16m per pixel; separate ground surface from B13, with use and ownership unconfirmed.

notes: Original 1m RH2000 ground; architectural openings and wall offsets remain model interpretations.
